sights.name: Venetian harbor and lighthouse
sights.summary: One of the prettiest harbors in Greece, ringed by colored houses.

sights.name: Old town lanes and Topanas
sights.summary: A maze of Venetian lanes with flowers, cafés and leather shops.

sights.name: Church of Saint Nicholas, Splantzia
sights.summary: A church with both a bell tower and a minaret.

sights.name: Firkas fortress and Maritime Museum
sights.summary: The harbor fortress where the Greek flag was first raised over Crete.

sights.name: Etz Hayyim Synagogue
sights.summary: Until 1999 Etz Hayyim was a house of prayer that remained the sole Jewish monument on Crete after the destruction of Crete's Jewish community in 1944. Essential

sights.name: Balos lagoon
sights.travel: About 1 hour 30 minutes by car and a hike, or by boat from Kissamos. Tight on a port day.
sights.summary: A turquoise lagoon with pink sand on Crete's wild western tip.

sights.name: Souda Bay War Cemetery
sights.travel: Right by the cruise port: 5 minutes by taxi.
sights.summary: A peaceful Commonwealth cemetery for those who fell in the Battle of Crete.
